title: Frosty Snowflakes: Why No Two Snowflakes Are Ever Identical!

lines.text: Dance, dance, little snowflake, tumbling gently from the sky!
Is it really true that no two snowflakes on Earth are ever identical?
lines.caps: Is it really *TRUE | that no two snowflakes on *EARTH | are ever *IDENTICAL?

lines.text: Yes! High in the frosty clouds, water freezes around a tiny speck of dust!
lines.caps: *YES! High in the *FROSTY | clouds, water freezes *AROUND | a tiny speck of *DUST!

lines.text: Water molecules always link up into a six-sided hexagonal crystal shape!
lines.caps: Water molecules always *LINK | up into a *SIX-SIDED | hexagonal crystal *SHAPE!

lines.text: As the snowflake drifts down, wind, temperature, and humidity change every second!
lines.caps: As the snowflake *DRIFTS | down, wind, temperature, and *HUMIDITY | change every *SECOND!

lines.text: Each branch grows differently based on the exact path it travels through the air!
lines.caps: Each branch grows *DIFFERENTLY | based on the exact *PATH | it travels through the *AIR!

lines.text: With trillions of possibilities, every single flake is a one-of-a-kind frozen artwork!
lines.caps: With trillions of *POSSIBILITIES, | every single flake is a *ONE-OF-A-KIND | frozen *ARTWORK!

lines.text: Now you know the winter magic behind every falling snowflake!
lines.caps: Now you *KNOW | the winter *MAGIC | behind every falling *SNOWFLAKE!
